newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT hopes to cut long-distance phone rate by March.
newsitem.headline: NTT hopes to cut long-distance phone rate by March.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) said on Wednesday that it hopes to cut domestic long-distance phone rates by the end of March 1997.

"We hope to take, by the end of March, one step towards achieving our goal of lowering domestic long-distance phone rates to 100 yen by 2000," NTT president Junichiro Miyazu told a regular news conference.
He did not elaborate on the extent of the possible rate cuts.
Currently NTT, Japan's biggest domestic telecommunications company, charges 140 yen per three minutes for long-distance phone calls.
